title: Preparations for the Temple

questions.question: What two structures did Solomon purpose to build?
options: A temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself
questions.correctAnswer: A temple for the LORD and a royal palace for himself
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:1 (ESV): "Now Solomon purposed to build a temple for the name of the LORD, and a royal palace for himself."

questions.question: To whom did Solomon send word for help with materials?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:3 (ESV): "And Solomon sent word to Hiram the king of Tyre..."

questions.question: What materials did Solomon request from Hiram?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:8 (ESV): "Send me also cedar, cypress, and algum timber from Lebanon..."

questions.question: What did Solomon say about the house he was building?
options: It is to be great, for our God is greater than all gods
It will be small but beautiful
questions.correctAnswer: It is to be great, for our God is greater than all gods
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:5 (ESV): "The house that I am to build will be great, for our God is greater than all gods."

questions.question: What did Solomon offer in exchange for the timber?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:10 (ESV): "I will give for your servants... 20,000 cors of crushed wheat, 20,000 cors of barley, 20,000 baths of wine, and 20,000 baths of oil."

questions.question: How many men did Solomon assign to bear burdens?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:2 (ESV): "And Solomon assigned 70,000 men to bear burdens..."

questions.question: How many men were assigned to quarry in the hill country?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:2 (ESV): "...and 80,000 to quarry in the hill country..."

questions.question: What specific craftsman did Hiram send to Solomon?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:13 (ESV): "Now I have sent a skilled man, who has understanding, Huram-abi..."

questions.question: Of what lineage was Huram-abi?
options: Son of a woman of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre
questions.correctAnswer: Son of a woman of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:14 (ESV): "the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre..."

questions.question: Where would the timber be floated to by sea?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:16 (ESV): "...we will... bring it to you in rafts by sea to Joppa..."

questions.question: Who were the men Solomon numbered for the labor force?
options: All the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: All the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:17 (ESV): "Then Solomon counted all the resident aliens who were in the land of Israel..."

questions.question: Why did Hiram bless the LORD God of Israel?
options: Because He made heaven and earth and gave David a wise son
questions.correctAnswer: Because He made heaven and earth and gave David a wise son
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:12 (ESV): "...Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who made heaven and earth, who has given King David a wise son..."

questions.question: What question did Solomon ask regarding the building of the temple?
options: Who is able to build him a house, since heaven, even highest heaven, cannot contain him?
questions.correctAnswer: Who is able to build him a house, since heaven, even highest heaven, cannot contain him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:6 (ESV): "But who is able to build him a house, since heaven, even highest heaven, cannot contain him?"

questions.question: What fabrics was Huram-abi trained to work in?
options: Purple, blue, and crimson fabrics and fine linen
questions.correctAnswer: Purple, blue, and crimson fabrics and fine linen
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 2:14 (ESV): "...and in purple, blue, and crimson fabrics and fine linen..."

key_verse_text: The house that I am to build will be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
